_doc: Structured wilderness, generated per anchor cell (lazy, seeded). Farms: farmhouse + fenced field + pasture sheep + track to the road. Outcrops: rock clusters (hills mostly) with an ore/rock node. Streams: 1-tile wadeable water lines with reeds and fishing spots. Build sites: unfinished frames near roads. Woods: dense trees inside forest, broken edge with undergrowth spilling out. Life: meadow flowers, bushes, stumps.
